sources.title: 青云阁 Acer Palmatum 'Seiun Kaku'
sources.description: 青云阁1974 年在日本关西地区被发现，于 2008 年左右进入美国 ，意为 " 云中的蓝绿色宫殿 " 。 是一款生长紧凑的矮生品种，因为这种生长习性所以外观看起来和三河八房有相似之处。 春天黄绿色的叶子在夏天变成深绿色，秋天颜色是明亮的火红色。 地栽的 成年树高约2 m 左右 。

rhs.description: Upright, flat-topped, deciduous shrubby tree about 2-3m tall, with overlapping leaves, light green when young then mid-green through summer through to autumn gold, each with long, narrow lobes. Inconspicuous red-purple flowers in spring may be followed by winged, purple fruits

attributes.suggested_uses: City/Courtyard Gardens, Cottage/Informal Garden, Flower borders and beds, Patio/Container Plants
attributes.hort_group_description: Acers in this palmatum group have small, palm-shaped leaves with coarsely-toothed edges

care.cultivation: Grow in any moisture-retentive, well-drained soil in a sheltered position. Leaf colour is best in partial shade, although full sun can be tolerated if soil is reliably moist. Leaf scorch can be caused by lack of soil moisture or excessive exposure. Suits container cultivation but attention to watering is needed in dry spells during the growing season. See Japanese maples cultivation
care.pruning: Pruning group 1 from late autumn to midwinter only
care.propagation: Propagate by layering in autumn, grafting in late winter or softwood cuttings

resistance.pest: May be susceptible to Acer gall mite, aphids , caterpillars and horse chestnut scale
resistance.disease: May be susceptible to Verticillium wilt , Acer leaf scorch and honey fungus

descriptions_zh.preferred: 该品种为直立、平顶状灌木，高可达 10 英尺（3 米），外形类似生长更旺盛的 ‘Mikawa yatsubusa’。 其叶片小至中等大小，形态也很相似，裂片为长卵形，先端细长尖锐，其中中央裂片最长。 叶缘具显著而粗大的锯齿。 与 ‘Mikawa yatsubusa’ 一样，叶片彼此重叠，如屋瓦覆叠。 叶色深绿，秋季转为极美的红色。 其名称可译作“青云之宫”。

attributes.suggested_uses: 城市庭院花园、乡村风或自然式花园、花境与花坛、庭院容器栽培
attributes.hort_group_description: 本 palmatum 组的槭树叶片较小，呈掌状，边缘具粗锯齿。

care.pruning: 修剪第 1 组：仅限在晚秋至仲冬期间进行。
care.propagation: 可于秋季行压条繁殖，于晚冬进行嫁接，或采用软枝扦插繁殖。
care.cultivation: 宜栽培于保水性好且排水良好的土壤中，选择避风庇护的位置。叶色在半阴环境下表现最佳；若土壤湿度稳定充足，也可耐全日照。土壤缺水或暴露过度易导致叶缘焦枯。适合容器栽培，但生长季遇干旱天气时需特别注意浇水。另见 Japanese maples cultivation。

resistance.pest: 可能易受槭瘿螨、蚜虫、毛虫和七叶树介壳虫危害
resistance.disease: 可能易感黄萎病、槭叶焦枯病和蜜环菌病

rhs_zh.description: 直立、顶端平展的落叶灌木状小乔木，高约 2-3 米。 叶片层层重叠，幼时浅绿色，夏季转中绿色，至秋季呈金黄色；每片叶具细长狭窄的裂片。 春季开不显眼的红紫色小花，随后可能结带翅的紫色翅果。

products.name: Acer palmatum 'Seiun kaku' Dwarf Japanese Maple
products.description_text: Acer palmatum ‘Seiun kaku’ is a Japanese cultivar has bright green leaves and red petioles. Similar to 'Mikawa yatsubusa' in that the leaves are layered one over the other like tiles on a roof but 'Seuin kaku' is much faster growing developing into a small more open and airy tree. 'Seiun kaku' finishes most years with a very nice deep red fall color. The Japanese name means blue-green tower or palace in the clouds. 10 year size: Height: 5-6 Feet Width: 2-3 Feet
